q_vocab_b1_01_001.question: apa does 'empresa' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_01_001.explanation: 'Empresa' berarti 'company' atau 'business'. itu mengacu pada a commercial organization.

q_vocab_b1_01_002.question: apa does 'sueldo' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_01_002.explanation: 'Sueldo' berarti 'salary' atau 'wage'. itu's ini/itu money kamu receive untuk milikmu work each month.

q_vocab_b1_01_003.question: Mi ___ me pidió que terminara el informe antes del viernes.
q_vocab_b1_01_003.explanation: 'Jefe' berarti 'boss'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'My boss asked me ke finish ini/itu report sebelum Friday.'

q_vocab_b1_01_004.question: apa does 'reunión' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_01_004.explanation: 'Reunión' berarti 'meeting'. di ini/itu workplace, 'tener una reunión' berarti 'ke memiliki a meeting'.

q_vocab_b1_01_005.question: apa does 'horas extra' berarti di a work context?
q_vocab_b1_01_005.explanation: 'Horas extra' berarti 'overtime'. itu mengacu pada additional hours worked beyond ini/itu beraturan schedule.

q_vocab_b1_01_006.question: I memiliki a job interview tomorrow.
q_vocab_b1_01_006.correct: Tengo una entrevista de trabajo mañana.
wrong: Tengo un contrato de trabajo mañana.
Tengo una reunión de trabajo mañana.
Tengo un puesto de trabajo mañana.

q_vocab_b1_01_007.question: apa does 'contratar' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_01_007.explanation: 'Contratar' berarti 'ke hire' atau 'ke employ'. ini/itu opposite adalah 'despedir' (ke fire).

q_vocab_b1_01_008.question: El empleado trabaja a tiempo parcial en la oficina.
q_vocab_b1_01_008.correct: The employee works part-time at the office.
wrong: The employee works full-time at the office.
The employee works overtime at the office.
The employer works part-time at the office.
q_vocab_b1_01_008.explanation: 'A tiempo parcial' berarti 'part-waktu'. 'Empleado' berarti 'employee'. ini/itu opposite adalah 'a tiempo completo' (full-waktu).

q_vocab_b1_01_009.question: kamu want ke apply untuk a new position. apa document do kamu need ke prepare?
q_vocab_b1_01_009.explanation: 'El currículum' (juga 'currículum vitae' atau CV) adalah document listing milikmu work experience dan education untuk job applications.
q_vocab_b1_01_009.context: Looking for a new job and preparing application materials

q_vocab_b1_01_010.question: milikmu company adalah letting orang go due ke budget cuts. apa adalah happening?
q_vocab_b1_01_010.explanation: 'Despedir' berarti 'ke fire' atau 'ke let go'. 'La empresa está despidiendo empleados' berarti 'ini/itu company adalah firing employees'.
q_vocab_b1_01_010.context: A company facing financial difficulties and reducing staff

q_vocab_b1_02_001.question: apa does 'beca' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_02_001.explanation: 'Beca' berarti 'scholarship'. Students bisa receive a 'beca' ke help pay untuk their studies.

q_vocab_b1_02_002.question: Los estudiantes deben ___ antes del 30 de septiembre.
q_vocab_b1_02_002.explanation: 'Matricularse' berarti 'ke enroll/register'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'Students harus enroll sebelum September 30th.'

q_vocab_b1_02_003.question: apa does 'aprobar' berarti di an academic context?
q_vocab_b1_02_003.explanation: 'Aprobar' berarti 'ke pass' an exam atau course. ini/itu opposite adalah 'suspender' (ke fail).

q_vocab_b1_02_004.question: apa does 'asignatura' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_02_004.explanation: 'Asignatura' berarti 'subject' atau 'course' di school. Misalnya, 'matemáticas es mi asignatura favorita'.

q_vocab_b1_02_005.question: She wants ke study a university degree.
q_vocab_b1_02_005.correct: Ella quiere estudiar una carrera universitaria.
wrong: Ella quiere aprobar una carrera universitaria.
Ella quiere suspender una carrera universitaria.
Ella quiere investigar una carrera universitaria.
q_vocab_b1_02_005.explanation: 'Carrera universitaria' berarti 'university degree'. 'Estudiar una carrera' adalah umum expression untuk pursuing a degree.

q_vocab_b1_02_006.question: apa does 'título' berarti di an educational context?
q_vocab_b1_02_006.explanation: 'Título' di education berarti 'degree' atau 'diploma'. 'Obtener un título' berarti 'ke obtain a degree'.

q_vocab_b1_02_007.question: A student asks about ini/itu next step setelah secondary school. apa level comes next di Spain?
q_vocab_b1_02_007.explanation: 'Bachillerato' adalah Spanyol equivalent dari upper secondary education (ages 16-18), taken setelah 'educación secundaria'.
q_vocab_b1_02_007.context: A 16-year-old student planning their educational path in Spain

q_vocab_b1_02_008.question: apa does 'nota' berarti di ini/itu phrase 'Saqué buenas notas este semestre'?
q_vocab_b1_02_008.explanation: 'Nota' di an academic context berarti 'grade' atau 'mark'. 'Sacar buenas notas' berarti 'ke get good grades'.

q_vocab_b1_02_009.question: Mi hermano suspendió tres asignaturas y tiene que repetir curso.
q_vocab_b1_02_009.correct: My brother failed three subjects and has to repeat the year.
wrong: My brother passed three subjects and has to repeat the year.
My brother failed three exams and has to change schools.
My brother dropped three subjects and has to take extra classes.
q_vocab_b1_02_009.explanation: 'Suspender' berarti 'ke fail'. 'Repetir curso' berarti 'ke repeat ini/itu school year'. ini adalah umum di ini/itu Spanyol education system.

q_vocab_b1_02_010.question: kamu adalah a professor guiding a student siapa wants ke do academic research. apa do kamu suggest?
q_vocab_b1_02_010.explanation: 'Investigar' berarti 'ke research' atau 'ke investigate'. 'Investigar sobre un tema' berarti 'ke research a topic'.
q_vocab_b1_02_010.context: A university professor advising a student about their thesis

q_vocab_b1_03_001.question: apa does 'medio ambiente' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_03_001.explanation: 'Medio ambiente' berarti 'environment' di ini/itu ecological sense. 'Proteger el medio ambiente' berarti 'ke protect ini/itu environment'.

q_vocab_b1_03_002.question: apa does 'contaminación' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_03_002.explanation: 'Contaminación' berarti 'pollution'. 'Contaminación del aire' adalah 'air pollution' dan 'contaminación del agua' adalah 'water pollution'.

q_vocab_b1_03_003.question: Es importante ___ el plástico para reducir los residuos.
q_vocab_b1_03_003.explanation: 'Reciclar' berarti 'ke recycle'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'Ini adalah important ke recycle plastic ke reduce waste.'

q_vocab_b1_03_004.question: apa does 'cambio climático' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_03_004.explanation: 'Cambio climático' berarti 'climate change'. itu mengacu pada long-term shifts di global suhus dan weather patterns.

q_vocab_b1_03_005.question: apa does 'energía renovable' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_03_005.explanation: 'Energía renovable' berarti 'renewable energy', seperti solar, wind, dan hydroelectric power.

q_vocab_b1_03_006.question: We harus protect endangered species.
q_vocab_b1_03_006.correct: Debemos proteger las especies en peligro.
wrong: Debemos contaminar las especies en peligro.
Debemos reciclar las especies en peligro.
Debemos deforestar las especies en peligro.
q_vocab_b1_03_006.explanation: 'Proteger' berarti 'ke protect'. 'Especies en peligro' berarti 'endangered species'.

q_vocab_b1_03_007.question: apa does 'deforestación' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_03_007.explanation: 'Deforestación' berarti 'deforestation', ini/itu clearing dari forests. itu adalah major environmental concern worldwide.

q_vocab_b1_03_008.question: Las emisiones de CO2 están aumentando cada año.
q_vocab_b1_03_008.correct: CO2 emissions are increasing every year.
wrong: CO2 emissions are decreasing every year.
CO2 recycling is increasing every year.
CO2 ecosystems are increasing every year.
q_vocab_b1_03_008.explanation: 'Emisiones' berarti 'emissions'. 'Aumentar' berarti 'ke increase'. ini sentence discusses rising carbon dioxide levels.

q_vocab_b1_03_009.question: milikmu city adalah launching a new green initiative. apa akan menjadi a good sustainability goal?
q_vocab_b1_03_009.correct: Promover la sostenibilidad y el reciclaje.
wrong: Reducir el uso de energía renovable.
q_vocab_b1_03_009.explanation: 'Sostenibilidad' berarti 'sustainability'. Promoting sustainability dan recycling adalah umum environmental goal.
q_vocab_b1_03_009.context: A city council meeting discussing environmental policies

q_vocab_b1_03_010.question: kamu see a factory dumping waste into a river. bagaimana do kamu describe ini?
q_vocab_b1_03_010.correct: La fábrica está contaminando el río.
wrong: La fábrica está reciclando el río.
La fábrica está protegiendo el río.
La fábrica está renovando el río.
q_vocab_b1_03_010.explanation: 'Contaminar' berarti 'ke pollute'. 'Contaminar el río' berarti 'ke pollute ini/itu river'.
q_vocab_b1_03_010.context: Witnessing industrial pollution near a residential area

q_vocab_b1_04_001.question: apa does 'periodista' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_04_001.explanation: 'Periodista' berarti 'journalist'. itu comes dari 'periódico' (newspaper). A periodista writes untuk media outlets.

q_vocab_b1_04_002.question: El ___ de hoy tiene un artículo muy interesante sobre política.
q_vocab_b1_04_002.explanation: 'Periódico' berarti 'newspaper'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'Today's newspaper memiliki a sangat interesting artikel about politics.'

q_vocab_b1_04_003.question: apa does 'redes sociales' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_04_003.explanation: 'Redes sociales' berarti 'social media' atau 'social networks'. itu mengacu pada platforms like Instagram, X, dan Facebook.

q_vocab_b1_04_004.question: apa does 'titular' berarti di a newspaper?
q_vocab_b1_04_004.explanation: 'Titular' berarti 'headline' kapan referring ke newspapers. itu's ini/itu main title dari a news story.

q_vocab_b1_04_005.question: ini/itu magazine published an artikel about climate change.
q_vocab_b1_04_005.correct: La revista publicó un artículo sobre el cambio climático.
wrong: La revista informó un artículo sobre el cambio climático.
El periódico publicó una noticia sobre el cambio climático.
La revista anunció un artículo sobre el cambio climático.
q_vocab_b1_04_005.explanation: 'Publicar' berarti 'ke publish'. 'Revista' berarti 'magazine'. 'Publicar un artículo' adalah standard expression.

q_vocab_b1_04_006.question: apa does 'publicidad' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_04_006.explanation: 'Publicidad' berarti 'advertising'. 'Anuncio' adalah single 'advertisement', sementara 'publicidad' adalah broader concept.

q_vocab_b1_04_007.question: kamu adalah watching TV dan a commercial break starts. apa adalah being shown?
q_vocab_b1_04_007.explanation: 'Anuncio' berarti 'advertisement' atau 'commercial'. During commercial breaks, kamu see 'anuncios'.

q_vocab_b1_04_008.question: apa does 'prensa' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_04_008.explanation: 'Prensa' berarti 'ini/itu press' atau 'media' collectively. 'Libertad de prensa' berarti 'freedom dari ini/itu press'.

q_vocab_b1_04_009.question: La cadena de televisión informó sobre el terremoto.
q_vocab_b1_04_009.correct: The television channel reported on the earthquake.
wrong: The television chain informed about the earthquake.
The newspaper reported on the earthquake.
The television channel published the earthquake.
q_vocab_b1_04_009.explanation: 'Cadena de televisión' berarti 'television channel/network'. 'Informar sobre' berarti 'ke report on'.

q_vocab_b1_04_010.question: kamu want ke stay informed about current events di Spain. apa do kamu follow?
q_vocab_b1_04_010.explanation: 'Noticias' berarti 'news'. Following 'las noticias' keeps kamu informed about current events.
q_vocab_b1_04_010.context: A foreigner living in Spain who wants to know what's happening in the country

q_vocab_b1_05_001.question: apa does 'exposición' berarti di an art context?
q_vocab_b1_05_001.explanation: 'Exposición' berarti 'exhibition' di ini/itu context dari art. 'Ir a una exposición' berarti 'ke go ke an exhibition'.

q_vocab_b1_05_002.question: apa does 'obra de arte' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_05_002.explanation: 'Obra de arte' berarti 'work dari art'. 'Obra' alone bisa berarti 'work' (literary, artistic) atau 'construction work'.

q_vocab_b1_05_003.question: El ___ del museo contiene cuadros de Picasso y Dalí.
q_vocab_b1_05_003.explanation: 'Galería' bisa refer ke a gallery atau section within a museum. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'ini/itu museum's gallery contains paintings oleh Picasso dan Dalí.'

q_vocab_b1_05_004.question: apa does 'patrimonio cultural' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_05_004.explanation: 'Patrimonio cultural' berarti 'cultural heritage'. itu mengacu pada ini/itu traditions, art, dan monuments valued oleh a society.

q_vocab_b1_05_005.question: apa does 'escultura' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_05_005.explanation: 'Escultura' berarti 'sculpture'. A sculptor ('escultor') creates three-dimensional works dari art.

q_vocab_b1_05_006.question: ini/itu writer published his latest novel last month.
q_vocab_b1_05_006.correct: El escritor publicó su última novela el mes pasado.
wrong: El pintor publicó su última novela el mes pasado.
El escritor pintó su última novela el mes pasado.
El director publicó su última novela el mes pasado.

q_vocab_b1_05_007.question: apa does 'cuadro' berarti di art?
q_vocab_b1_05_007.explanation: 'Cuadro' berarti 'painting' (a framed artwork). itu bisa juga berarti 'picture' di general kapan displayed on a wall.

q_vocab_b1_05_008.question: La arquitectura de Barcelona es famosa en todo el mundo.
q_vocab_b1_05_008.correct: Barcelona's architecture is famous throughout the world.
wrong: Barcelona's art gallery is famous throughout the world.
Barcelona's museum is famous throughout the world.
Barcelona's sculpture is famous throughout the world.
q_vocab_b1_05_008.explanation: 'Arquitectura' berarti 'architecture'. Barcelona adalah known untuk Gaudí's unique architectural works.

q_vocab_b1_05_009.question: kamu visit a museum dan want ke see ini/itu Spanyol masters. apa do kamu ask untuk?
q_vocab_b1_05_009.correct: ¿Dónde están los cuadros de los pintores españoles?
wrong: ¿Dónde están las novelas de los escritores españoles?
¿Dónde están los poemas de los directores españoles?
¿Dónde están las esculturas de los escritores españoles?
q_vocab_b1_05_009.explanation: 'Pintores' berarti 'painters'. 'Cuadros' berarti 'paintings'. ini adalah benar way ke ask about paintings oleh Spanyol artists.
q_vocab_b1_05_009.context: Visiting the Prado Museum in Madrid

q_vocab_b1_05_010.question: kamu attend a poetry reading event. apa adalah kamu listening ke?
q_vocab_b1_05_010.explanation: 'Poema' berarti 'poem'. A 'recital de poesía' (poetry reading) features poets reading their 'poemas' aloud.
q_vocab_b1_05_010.context: A cultural event at a literary café

q_vocab_b1_06_001.question: apa does 'enamorarse' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_06_001.explanation: 'Enamorarse' berarti 'ke fall di love'. itu's a reflexive kata kerja: 'Me enamoré de ella' (I fell di love dengan her).

q_vocab_b1_06_002.question: Mi hermana se ___ con su novio después de cinco años juntos.
q_vocab_b1_06_002.explanation: 'Casarse' berarti 'ke get married'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'My sister got married ke her boyfriend setelah five years together.'

q_vocab_b1_06_003.question: apa does 'llevarse bien' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_06_003.explanation: 'Llevarse bien' berarti 'ke get along well' dengan someone. ini/itu opposite adalah 'llevarse mal' (ke not get along).

q_vocab_b1_06_004.question: apa does 'confianza' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_06_004.explanation: 'Confianza' berarti 'trust' di relationships. 'Tener confianza en alguien' berarti 'ke trust someone'.

q_vocab_b1_06_005.question: mereka broke up setelah a big argument.
q_vocab_b1_06_005.correct: Rompieron después de una gran discusión.
wrong: Se casaron después de una gran discusión.
Se enamoraron después de una gran discusión.
Se apoyaron después de una gran discusión.
q_vocab_b1_06_005.explanation: 'Romper (con alguien)' berarti 'ke break up (dengan someone)'. 'Discusión' berarti 'argument'.

q_vocab_b1_06_006.question: apa does 'echar de menos' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_06_006.explanation: 'Echar de menos' berarti 'ke miss' someone atau something. 'Te echo de menos' berarti 'I miss kamu'.

q_vocab_b1_06_007.question: milikmu best friend adalah going through a difficult waktu. apa seharusnya kamu do?
q_vocab_b1_06_007.explanation: 'Apoyar' berarti 'ke support'. Being a good friend berarti supporting ('apoyar') orang during hard times.
q_vocab_b1_06_007.context: A close friend recently lost their job and feels discouraged

q_vocab_b1_06_008.question: apa does 'perdonar' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_06_008.explanation: 'Perdonar' berarti 'ke forgive'. 'Te perdono' berarti 'I forgive kamu'. itu bisa juga berarti 'excuse me' di polite contexts.

q_vocab_b1_06_009.question: Después de divorciarse, ella empezó una nueva relación.
q_vocab_b1_06_009.correct: Setelah bercerai, dia memulai hubungan baru.
wrong: Setelah menikah, dia memulai hubungan baru.
Setelah jatuh cinta, dia memulai persahabatan baru.
Setelah putus, dia memulai karier baru.
q_vocab_b1_06_009.explanation: 'Divorciarse' berarti 'bercerai'. 'Relación' berarti 'hubungan'. Kalimat ini menggambarkan melangkah maju setelah perceraian.

q_vocab_b1_06_010.question: Two friends haven't spoken di months setelah a disagreement. One wants ke reconnect. apa seharusnya mereka do?
q_vocab_b1_06_010.correct: Debería llamar a su amigo y intentar perdonar.
wrong: Debería discutir más con su amigo.
Debería echar de menos a su amigo en silencio.
q_vocab_b1_06_010.explanation: 'Perdonar' berarti 'ke forgive'. 'Amistad' berarti 'friendship'. Forgiving adalah first step ke restoring temanship.
q_vocab_b1_06_010.context: Two long-time friends who had a falling out over a misunderstanding

q_vocab_b1_07_001.question: apa does 'ley' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_07_001.explanation: 'Ley' berarti 'law'. 'Cumplir la ley' berarti 'ke obey ini/itu law'. 'Ley' mengacu pada a specific regulation atau statute.

q_vocab_b1_07_002.question: apa does 'abogado' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_07_002.explanation: 'Abogado' berarti 'lawyer' atau 'attorney'. An abogado defends atau represents clients di legal matters.

q_vocab_b1_07_003.question: El ___ declaró al acusado culpable del delito.
q_vocab_b1_07_003.explanation: 'Juez' berarti 'judge'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'ini/itu judge declared ini/itu defendant guilty dari ini/itu crime.'

q_vocab_b1_07_004.question: apa does 'derechos humanos' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_07_004.explanation: 'Derechos humanos' berarti 'human rights'. 'Derecho' berarti both 'right' (entitlement) dan 'law' (field dari study).

q_vocab_b1_07_005.question: apa does 'culpable' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_07_005.explanation: 'Culpable' berarti 'guilty'. ini/itu opposite adalah 'inocente' (innocent). 'Declarar culpable' berarti 'ke find guilty'.

q_vocab_b1_07_006.question: Everyone memiliki ini/itu right ke freedom dari expression.
q_vocab_b1_07_006.correct: Todos tienen derecho a la libertad de expresión.
wrong: Todos tienen justicia a la libertad de expresión.
Todos tienen ley a la libertad de expresión.
Todos tienen juicio a la libertad de expresión.
q_vocab_b1_07_006.explanation: 'Derecho' berarti 'right'. 'Libertad de expresión' berarti 'freedom dari expression'. 'Tener derecho a' berarti 'ke memiliki ini/itu right ke'.

q_vocab_b1_07_007.question: apa does 'denunciar' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_07_007.explanation: 'Denunciar' berarti 'ke report' a crime atau wrongdoing ke ini/itu authorities. 'Poner una denuncia' berarti 'ke file a report'.

q_vocab_b1_07_008.question: La víctima declaró ante el juez durante el juicio.
q_vocab_b1_07_008.correct: The victim testified before the judge during the trial.
wrong: The victim declared to the lawyer during the trial.
The guilty party testified before the judge during the crime.
The victim reported to the judge during the law.
q_vocab_b1_07_008.explanation: 'Víctima' berarti 'victim'. 'Juicio' berarti 'trial'. 'Declarar' di sini berarti 'ke testify'.

q_vocab_b1_07_009.question: kamu witness a robbery. apa seharusnya kamu do?
q_vocab_b1_07_009.correct: Denunciar el delito a la policía.
wrong: Defender al culpable ante la policía.
Ignorar la justicia y el delito.
Juzgar al inocente en la calle.
q_vocab_b1_07_009.explanation: 'Denunciar' berarti 'ke report'. 'Delito' berarti 'crime'. kamu seharusnya report crimes ke ini/itu police.
q_vocab_b1_07_009.context: Walking home at night and seeing someone stealing from a store

q_vocab_b1_07_010.question: A group dari citizens adalah protesting untuk equal rights. apa adalah mereka demanding?
q_vocab_b1_07_010.explanation: 'Igualdad' berarti 'equality'. 'Igualdad de derechos' berarti 'equal rights', a fundamental demand di social movements.
q_vocab_b1_07_010.context: A peaceful demonstration in the city center about civil rights

q_vocab_b1_08_001.question: apa does 'descubrimiento' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_08_001.explanation: 'Descubrimiento' berarti 'discovery'. itu comes dari kata kerja 'descubrir' (ke discover).

q_vocab_b1_08_002.question: Los ___ trabajan en el laboratorio analizando datos.
q_vocab_b1_08_002.explanation: 'Científicos' berarti 'scientists'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'ini/itu scientists work di ini/itu laboratory analyzing data.'

q_vocab_b1_08_003.question: apa does 'investigación' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_08_003.explanation: 'Investigación' berarti 'research' di a scientific context. 'Realizar una investigación' berarti 'ke carry out research'.

q_vocab_b1_08_004.question: apa does 'inteligencia artificial' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_08_004.explanation: 'Inteligencia artificial' berarti 'artificial intelligence' (AI). itu's a rapidly growing field di technology.

q_vocab_b1_08_005.question: ini/itu scientist invented a new type dari battery.
q_vocab_b1_08_005.correct: El científico inventó un nuevo tipo de batería.
wrong: El científico descubrió un nuevo tipo de batería.
El científico demostró un nuevo tipo de batería.
El científico experimentó un nuevo tipo de batería.
q_vocab_b1_08_005.explanation: 'Inventar' berarti 'ke invent' (create something new). 'Descubrir' berarti 'ke discover' (find something existing).

q_vocab_b1_08_006.question: apa does 'demostrar' berarti di a scientific context?
q_vocab_b1_08_006.explanation: 'Demostrar' di science berarti 'ke prove' atau 'ke demonstrate' a hypothesis atau theory through evidence.

q_vocab_b1_08_007.question: A research team announces their findings. bagaimana do mereka describe presenting evidence untuk their hypothesis?
q_vocab_b1_08_007.correct: Hemos demostrado nuestra teoría con los datos.
wrong: Hemos inventado nuestra teoría con los datos.
Hemos descubierto nuestra teoría con los datos.
Hemos experimentado nuestra teoría con los datos.
q_vocab_b1_08_007.explanation: 'Demostrar' berarti 'ke prove'. 'Teoría' berarti 'theory'. Scientists 'demuestran' (prove) theories dengan data.
q_vocab_b1_08_007.context: A press conference about a major scientific breakthrough

q_vocab_b1_08_008.question: apa does 'dato' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_08_008.explanation: 'Dato' berarti 'data point' atau 'piece dari information'. ini/itu jamak 'datos' berarti 'data'. 'Base de datos' berarti 'database'.

q_vocab_b1_08_009.question: Los estudiantes realizaron un experimento en el laboratorio.
q_vocab_b1_08_009.correct: The students carried out an experiment in the laboratory.
wrong: The students discovered an experiment in the laboratory.
The scientists realized an experiment in the library.
The students researched an experiment in the classroom.
q_vocab_b1_08_009.explanation: 'Realizar un experimento' berarti 'ke carry out an experiment'. 'Laboratorio' berarti 'laboratory'.

q_vocab_b1_08_010.question: kamu read about a new technology itu bisa learn dan make decisions. apa adalah itu called dalam bahasa Spanyol?
q_vocab_b1_08_010.explanation: 'Inteligencia artificial' (AI) mengacu pada technology itu bisa learn, reason, dan make decisions autonomously.
q_vocab_b1_08_010.context: Reading a tech magazine article about machine learning advances

q_vocab_b1_09_001.question: apa does 'impuestos' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_09_001.explanation: 'Impuestos' berarti 'taxes'. 'Pagar impuestos' berarti 'ke pay taxes'. itu comes dari 'imponer' (ke impose).

q_vocab_b1_09_002.question: apa does 'desempleo' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_09_002.explanation: 'Desempleo' berarti 'unemployment'. ini/itu prefix 'des-' indicates negation. 'La tasa de desempleo' berarti 'ini/itu unemployment rate'.

q_vocab_b1_09_003.question: Es importante ___ dinero cada mes para el futuro.
q_vocab_b1_09_003.explanation: 'Ahorrar' berarti 'ke save' money. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'Ini adalah important ke save money every month untuk ini/itu future.'

q_vocab_b1_09_004.question: apa does 'presupuesto' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_09_004.explanation: 'Presupuesto' berarti 'budget'. 'El presupuesto del gobierno' berarti 'ini/itu government's budget'.

q_vocab_b1_09_005.question: apa does 'inflación' refer ke di economics?
q_vocab_b1_09_005.correct: a general increase in prices over time
wrong: a decrease in the value of exports
a rise in stock market values
q_vocab_b1_09_005.explanation: 'Inflación' berarti 'inflation', ini/itu sustained increase di ini/itu general price level dari goods dan services.

q_vocab_b1_09_006.question: He decided ke invest di real estate.
q_vocab_b1_09_006.explanation: 'Invertir' berarti 'ke invest'. 'Bienes raíces' berarti 'real estate'. Investing adalah different dari saving atau spending.

q_vocab_b1_09_007.question: apa does 'deuda' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_09_007.explanation: 'Deuda' berarti 'debt'. 'Tener deudas' berarti 'ke memiliki debts'. 'Deuda pública' adalah 'national/public debt'.

q_vocab_b1_09_008.question: El crecimiento económico del país fue del 3% este año.
q_vocab_b1_09_008.correct: The country's economic growth was 3% this year.
wrong: The country's economic spending was 3% this year.
The country's economic debt was 3% this year.
The country's economic unemployment was 3% this year.
q_vocab_b1_09_008.explanation: 'Crecimiento económico' berarti 'economic growth'. itu measures bagaimana much a country's economy memiliki expanded.

q_vocab_b1_09_009.question: kamu want ke start a small business. apa do kamu need ke create first?
q_vocab_b1_09_009.explanation: 'Presupuesto' berarti 'budget'. 'Negocio' berarti 'business'. A budget adalah essential kapan starting a new business.
q_vocab_b1_09_009.context: Planning to open a small café in your neighborhood

q_vocab_b1_09_010.question: ini/itu government needs ke address rising unemployment. apa adalah ini/itu issue?
q_vocab_b1_09_010.correct: El gobierno necesita abordar el aumento del desempleo.
wrong: El gobierno necesita abordar el aumento de la inversión.
El gobierno necesita abordar el aumento del mercado.
El gobierno necesita abordar el aumento del ahorro.
q_vocab_b1_09_010.explanation: 'Desempleo' berarti 'unemployment'. 'Abordar' berarti 'ke address/tackle'. Rising unemployment adalah serious economic concern.
q_vocab_b1_09_010.context: A news report about the country's economic challenges

q_vocab_b1_10_001.question: apa does 'en mi opinión' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_10_001.explanation: 'En mi opinión' berarti 'di my opinion'. itu's one dari ini/itu paling umum ways untuk mengungkapkan a personal viewpoint dalam bahasa Spanyol.

q_vocab_b1_10_002.question: Creo que el cambio climático es un problema grave; ___, hay gente que no está de acuerdo.
q_vocab_b1_10_002.explanation: 'Sin embargo' berarti 'namun' atau 'nevertheless'. itu introduces a contrasting idea. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'I think climate change adalah serious problem; namun, di sana adalah orang siapa disagree.'

q_vocab_b1_10_003.question: apa does 'estoy de acuerdo' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_10_003.explanation: 'Estoy de acuerdo' berarti 'I agree'. ini/itu opposite adalah 'estoy en desacuerdo' atau 'no estoy de acuerdo' (I disagree).

q_vocab_b1_10_004.question: apa does 'además' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_10_004.explanation: 'Además' berarti 'furthermore', 'moreover', atau 'besides'. itu's used ke add information ke an argument.

q_vocab_b1_10_005.question: di conclusion, education adalah ini/itu key ke progress.
q_vocab_b1_10_005.correct: En conclusión, la educación es la clave del progreso.
wrong: Sin embargo, la educación es la clave del progreso.
Por un lado, la educación es la clave del progreso.
A pesar de, la educación es la clave del progreso.
q_vocab_b1_10_005.explanation: 'En conclusión' berarti 'di conclusion'. itu's used ke summarize ini/itu main point dari sebuah argumen atau essay.

q_vocab_b1_10_006.question: apa does 'a pesar de' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_10_006.explanation: 'A pesar de' berarti 'despite' atau 'di spite dari'. 'A pesar de la lluvia, salimos' berarti 'Despite ini/itu rain, we went out'.

q_vocab_b1_10_007.question: kamu adalah di a debate dan want ke present two sides dari an argument. Which expression do kamu use?
q_vocab_b1_10_007.correct: por un lado... por otro lado...
q_vocab_b1_10_007.explanation: 'Por un lado... por otro lado...' berarti 'on one hand... on ini/itu other hand...' itu's used ke present contrasting viewpoints.
q_vocab_b1_10_007.context: A classroom debate about whether social media adalah beneficial for society

q_vocab_b1_10_008.question: apa does 'por lo tanto' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_10_008.explanation: 'Por lo tanto' berarti 'oleh karena itu' atau 'consequently'. itu introduces a logical conclusion dari previous statements.

q_vocab_b1_10_009.question: Aunque el examen fue difícil, todos los estudiantes aprobaron.
q_vocab_b1_10_009.correct: Although the exam was difficult, all the students passed.
wrong: Because the exam was difficult, all the students passed.
Despite the exam, all the students failed.
Therefore the exam was difficult, and all the students passed.
q_vocab_b1_10_009.explanation: 'Aunque' berarti 'meskipun' atau 'even though'. itu introduces a concessive clause. 'Aprobar' berarti 'ke pass'.

q_vocab_b1_10_010.question: kamu want ke strongly emphasize itu something adalah true di a debate. Which expression fits best?
q_vocab_b1_10_010.explanation: 'Sin duda' berarti 'tanpa a doubt' atau 'undoubtedly'. itu's used ke strongly affirm a statement.
q_vocab_b1_10_010.context: Making your final point in a persuasive essay about renewable energy

q_vocab_b1_11_001.question: apa does 'tratamiento' berarti di a medical context?
q_vocab_b1_11_001.explanation: 'Tratamiento' berarti 'treatment'. 'Seguir un tratamiento' berarti 'ke follow a treatment' prescribed oleh a doctor.

q_vocab_b1_11_002.question: apa does 'diagnóstico' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_11_002.explanation: 'Diagnóstico' berarti 'diagnosis'. ini/itu doctor gives a 'diagnóstico' setelah examining ini/itu patient.

q_vocab_b1_11_003.question: El médico me mandó un ___ para comprobar mis niveles de colesterol.
q_vocab_b1_11_003.explanation: 'Análisis de sangre' berarti 'blood test'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'ini/itu doctor ordered a blood test ke check my cholesterol levels.'

q_vocab_b1_11_004.question: apa does 'vacuna' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_11_004.explanation: 'Vacuna' berarti 'vaccine'. 'Vacunarse' berarti 'ke get vaccinated'. 'Ponerse una vacuna' berarti 'ke get a vaccine'.

q_vocab_b1_11_005.question: apa does 'crónico' berarti kapan a doctor describes an illness?
q_vocab_b1_11_005.explanation: 'Crónico' berarti 'chronic', referring ke a kondisi itu persists over a long waktu. 'Enfermedad crónica' berarti 'chronic illness'.

q_vocab_b1_11_006.question: ini/itu patient adalah recovering setelah ini/itu surgery.
q_vocab_b1_11_006.correct: El paciente se está recuperando después de la cirugía.
wrong: El paciente se está operando después de la cirugía.
El paciente se está diagnosticando después de la cirugía.
El paciente se está vacunando después de la cirugía.
q_vocab_b1_11_006.explanation: 'Recuperarse' berarti 'ke recover'. 'Cirugía' (atau 'operación') berarti 'surgery'. Recovery follows an operation.

q_vocab_b1_11_007.question: apa does 'síntoma' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_11_007.explanation: 'Síntoma' berarti 'symptom'. 'Los síntomas de la gripe' berarti 'flu symptoms'. Doctors ask about symptoms ke make a diagnosis.

q_vocab_b1_11_008.question: Llamé a la ambulancia porque mi padre tenía una urgencia.
q_vocab_b1_11_008.correct: I called the ambulance because my father had an emergency.
wrong: I called the specialist because my father had an allergy.
I called the ambulance because my father had a treatment.
I called the hospital because my father had a diagnosis.
q_vocab_b1_11_008.explanation: 'Ambulancia' berarti 'ambulance'. 'Urgencia' berarti 'emergency'. kamu call an ambulance di medical emergencies.

q_vocab_b1_11_009.question: kamu memiliki a persistent allergic reaction. siapa seharusnya kamu see?
q_vocab_b1_11_009.explanation: 'Especialista' berarti 'specialist'. untuk persistent allergies ('alergias'), kamu seharusnya see an allergy specialist.
q_vocab_b1_11_009.context: Experiencing recurring skin rashes and sneezing for several weeks

q_vocab_b1_11_010.question: milikmu doctor says kamu need ongoing care untuk a condition itu won't fully go away. bagaimana does ini/itu doctor describe itu?
q_vocab_b1_11_010.correct: Es una enfermedad crónica que requiere tratamiento continuo.
wrong: Es una urgencia que requiere una operación inmediata.
Es una alergia que requiere una vacuna nueva.
Es un síntoma que requiere un análisis de sangre.
q_vocab_b1_11_010.explanation: 'Enfermedad crónica' berarti 'chronic illness'. 'Tratamiento continuo' berarti 'ongoing treatment'. Chronic kondisis require long-term management.
q_vocab_b1_11_010.context: A follow-up appointment where your doctor explains a long-term health kondisi

q_vocab_b1_12_001.question: apa does 'receta' berarti di a cooking context?
q_vocab_b1_12_001.explanation: 'Receta' berarti 'recipe' di cooking. itu juga berarti 'prescription' di a medical context. 'Seguir una receta' berarti 'ke follow a recipe'.

q_vocab_b1_12_002.question: Primero hay que ___ las patatas antes de freírlas.
q_vocab_b1_12_002.explanation: 'Pelar' berarti 'ke peel'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'First kamu memiliki ke peel ini/itu potatoes sebelum frying them.'

q_vocab_b1_12_003.question: apa does 'hervir' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_12_003.explanation: 'Hervir' berarti 'ke boil'. 'Hervir el agua' berarti 'ke boil ini/itu water'. itu's one dari ini/itu paling basic cooking techniques.

q_vocab_b1_12_004.question: apa does 'sartén' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_12_004.explanation: 'Sartén' berarti 'frying pan'. 'Freír en la sartén' berarti 'ke fry di ini/itu pan'. itu bisa feminin atau maskulin depending on ini/itu region.

q_vocab_b1_12_005.question: I need ke chop ini/itu onions untuk ini/itu sauce.
q_vocab_b1_12_005.correct: Necesito picar las cebollas para la salsa.
wrong: Necesito pelar las cebollas para la salsa.
Necesito hervir las cebollas para la salsa.
Necesito hornear las cebollas para la salsa.
q_vocab_b1_12_005.explanation: 'Picar' berarti 'ke chop' atau 'ke mince'. 'Cebolla' berarti 'onion'. Chopping adalah different dari peeling ('pelar').

q_vocab_b1_12_006.question: apa does 'hornear' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_12_006.explanation: 'Hornear' berarti 'ke bake' (di an oven). itu comes dari 'horno' (oven). 'Hornear un pastel' berarti 'ke bake a cake'.

q_vocab_b1_12_007.question: kamu're making a stew dan need ke cook itu gently untuk a long waktu. apa instruction do kamu follow?
q_vocab_b1_12_007.explanation: 'A fuego lento' berarti 'on low heat' atau 'ke simmer'. Stews adalah typically cooked slowly on low heat untuk ini/itu best flavor.
q_vocab_b1_12_007.context: Following a traditional Spanish stew recipe in the kitchen

q_vocab_b1_12_008.question: apa does 'añadir' berarti di a recipe?
q_vocab_b1_12_008.explanation: 'Añadir' berarti 'ke add'. di recipes, kamu sering see 'añadir sal al gusto' (add salt ke taste).

q_vocab_b1_12_009.question: Mezcla todos los ingredientes en la olla y ponla en el horno.
q_vocab_b1_12_009.correct: Mix all the ingredients in the pot and put it in the oven.
wrong: Chop all the ingredients in the pan and put it in the oven.
Mix all the recipes in the pot and put it on the stove.
Boil all the ingredients in the pan and put it in the microwave.
q_vocab_b1_12_009.explanation: 'Mezclar' berarti 'ke mix'. 'Olla' berarti 'pot'. 'Horno' berarti 'oven'. ini adalah umum cooking instruction.

q_vocab_b1_12_010.question: kamu want ke make grilled chicken untuk dinner. Which cooking method do kamu use?
q_vocab_b1_12_010.explanation: 'Asar' berarti 'ke roast' atau 'ke grill'. 'Asar el pollo' berarti 'ke roast/grill ini/itu chicken'. itu gives meat a crispy exterior.
q_vocab_b1_12_010.context: Preparing a Sunday family dinner with a barbecue

q_vocab_b1_13_001.question: apa does 'alquilar' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_13_001.explanation: 'Alquilar' berarti 'ke rent'. 'Alquilar un piso' berarti 'ke rent an apartment'. itu bisa berarti both ke rent out dan ke rent dari someone.

q_vocab_b1_13_002.question: apa does 'hipoteca' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_13_002.explanation: 'Hipoteca' berarti 'mortgage'. 'Pedir una hipoteca' berarti 'ke apply untuk a mortgage' at a bank ke buy property.

q_vocab_b1_13_003.question: Nos ___ a un barrio más tranquilo el mes que viene.
q_vocab_b1_13_003.explanation: 'Mudarse' berarti 'ke move (house)'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'We adalah moving ke a quieter neighborhood next month.'

q_vocab_b1_13_004.question: apa does 'propietario' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_13_004.explanation: 'Propietario' berarti 'owner' atau 'landlord'. ini/itu orang siapa owns a property. ini/itu tenant adalah 'inquilino'.

q_vocab_b1_13_005.question: apa does 'inquilino' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_13_005.explanation: 'Inquilino' berarti 'tenant', ini/itu orang siapa rents dan lives di a property owned oleh someone else.

q_vocab_b1_13_006.question: We need ke renovate ini/itu kitchen sebelum selling ini/itu house.
q_vocab_b1_13_006.correct: Necesitamos reformar la cocina antes de vender la casa.
wrong: Necesitamos alquilar la cocina antes de vender la casa.
Necesitamos mudarnos de la cocina antes de vender la casa.
Necesitamos comprar la cocina antes de vender la casa.
q_vocab_b1_13_006.explanation: 'Reformar' berarti 'ke renovate' atau 'ke remodel'. Renovating sebelum selling bisa increase property value.

q_vocab_b1_13_007.question: apa does 'gastos' refer ke di ini/itu context dari renting?
q_vocab_b1_13_007.explanation: 'Gastos' berarti 'expenses'. di renting, itu mengacu pada utility costs like water, electricity, dan community fees.

q_vocab_b1_13_008.question: El piso está en las afueras de la ciudad, pero tiene buen transporte.
q_vocab_b1_13_008.correct: The apartment is on the outskirts of the city, but it has good transportation.
wrong: The apartment is in the center of the city, but it has good transportation.
The house is outside the country, but it has good transportation.
The apartment is on the outskirts of the city, but it has a good garage.
q_vocab_b1_13_008.explanation: 'Afueras' berarti 'outskirts' atau 'suburbs'. 'Piso' berarti 'apartment' di Spain. Living on ini/itu outskirts sering berarti cheaper rent.

q_vocab_b1_13_009.question: kamu found an apartment kamu like. apa do kamu need ke sign sebelum moving di?
q_vocab_b1_13_009.explanation: 'Contrato de alquiler' berarti 'rental contract/lease'. kamu harus sign a lease sebelum moving into a rented apartment.
q_vocab_b1_13_009.context: Meeting with a landlord to finalize renting an apartment in Madrid

q_vocab_b1_13_010.question: kamu live di a building dan share umum areas dengan other residents. apa monthly fee do kamu pay?
q_vocab_b1_13_010.explanation: 'Gastos de comunidad' berarti 'community fees'. dalam bahasa Spanyol apartment buildings, residents pay monthly fees untuk shared areas dan services.
q_vocab_b1_13_010.context: Receiving the monthly bill for your apartment building's shared expenses

q_vocab_b1_14_001.question: apa does 'pobreza' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_14_001.explanation: 'Pobreza' berarti 'poverty'. 'Vivir en la pobreza' berarti 'ke live di poverty'. itu's a major global social issue.

q_vocab_b1_14_002.question: Muchos ___ tuvieron que abandonar su país por la guerra.
q_vocab_b1_14_002.explanation: 'Refugiados' berarti 'refugees'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'banyak refugees had ke leave their country karena dari ini/itu war.'

q_vocab_b1_14_003.question: apa does 'desigualdad' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_14_003.explanation: 'Desigualdad' berarti 'inequality'. 'Desigualdad social' berarti 'social inequality', referring ke unequal distribution dari resources dan opportunities.

q_vocab_b1_14_004.question: apa does 'discriminación' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_14_004.explanation: 'Discriminación' berarti 'discrimination'. 'Luchar contra la discriminación' berarti 'ke fight against discrimination'.

q_vocab_b1_14_005.question: ini/itu NGO helps immigrants integrate into society.
q_vocab_b1_14_005.correct: La ONG ayuda a los inmigrantes a integrarse en la sociedad.
wrong: La ONG ayuda a los voluntarios a integrarse en la sociedad.
La ONG ayuda a los inmigrantes a discriminarse en la sociedad.
La ONG ayuda a los refugiados a excluirse de la sociedad.
q_vocab_b1_14_005.explanation: 'ONG' berarti 'NGO' (non-governmental organization). 'Integrarse' berarti 'ke integrate'. NGOs sering help dengan immigrant integration.

q_vocab_b1_14_006.question: apa does 'voluntariado' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_14_006.explanation: 'Voluntariado' berarti 'volunteering' atau 'voluntary work'. 'Hacer voluntariado' berarti 'ke do volunteer work'.

q_vocab_b1_14_007.question: milikmu community center organizes help untuk underprivileged families. apa kind dari work adalah ini?
q_vocab_b1_14_007.explanation: 'Solidario' berarti 'supportive' atau 'charitable'. 'Trabajo solidario' mengacu pada charitable atau solidarity work itu helps those di need.
q_vocab_b1_14_007.context: A neighborhood initiative collecting food and clothing for families in need

q_vocab_b1_14_008.question: apa does 'exclusión social' berarti?
q_vocab_b1_14_008.explanation: 'Exclusión social' berarti 'social exclusion', kapan individuals atau groups adalah marginalized dari participating fully di society.

q_vocab_b1_14_009.question: La violencia de género es un problema grave que afecta a toda la sociedad.
q_vocab_b1_14_009.correct: Gender-based violence is a serious problem that affects all of society.
wrong: Gender inequality is a serious problem that affects all of society.
Social violence is a serious problem that affects all of the country.
Domestic discrimination is a serious problem that affects all of society.
q_vocab_b1_14_009.explanation: 'Violencia de género' berarti 'gender-based violence'. itu's a widely discussed social issue di Spain dan Latin America.

q_vocab_b1_14_010.question: kamu want ke help refugees di milikmu city. apa bisa kamu do?
q_vocab_b1_14_010.correct: Colaborar con una ONG que apoya a refugiados.
wrong: Discriminar a los refugiados de la ciudad.
Excluir a los refugiados de la sociedad.
Ignorar la inmigración en la ciudad.
q_vocab_b1_14_010.explanation: 'Colaborar' berarti 'ke collaborate' atau 'ke help'. Working dengan NGOs adalah one dari ini/itu best ways ke support refugees.
q_vocab_b1_14_010.context: Looking for ways to contribute to your local refugee support network
